features.zero_low_prompt_rule: raw epochs with prompt magnitude <=1e-8 are invalid; a node window requires >=1 valid raw epoch and finite output
features.cn0_context: median cn0_db_hz over [window_start-1s, window_start), never current window

stable_tracking.rule: earliest 20 consecutive 0.5 s receiver epochs with at least 4 valid PRNs

split.allocation: Hamilton largest remainder over eligible receiver epochs after reserving three guards; ties role order train,validation,calibration,holdout

paper_b0.loss: mean squared error over batch and 9 outputs
paper_b0.checkpoint_selection: strict minimum chronological validation loss; earliest epoch on exact tie
paper_b0.standardizer: feature mean and population std from train only; std<1e-6 becomes 1

nuisance.merge_order: exact stratum; adjacent C/N0 pair preferring lower pair for middle; all C/N0 preserving tracked-count; global

temporal.block_rule: non-overlapping 2 s blocks; if clean-train integrated autocorrelation time exceeds 2 s, use the smallest integer multiple of 0.5 s strictly greater than that IAT

ablations.H0: Historical-B0 exact frozen checkpoint and exact historical gate
ablations.A1: Paper-B0 with exact q50/q70/q80 binomial-tail and EWMA075 semantics recalibrated on Paper-B0 calibration only
ablations.A2: Paper-B0 A0 receiver score with calibration higher-q99 and no sequential accumulation
ablations.A3: B0-CS global PRN residual calibration without nuisance conditioning
ablations.A4: B0-CS nuisance-conditioned set score with calibration higher-q99 and no temporal accumulation
ablations.Full: nuisance-conditioned PRN e-mean, block calibration, sequential evidence
ablations.Linear-AR: fixed clean-only linear AR plus Full calibration
ablations.SimpleConsecutive: Paper-B0 A0 higher-q99 with 3 consecutive receiver epochs

controls.raw_iq_awgn: run only if receiver recalculation inputs/executable/lineage are verified; otherwise UNAVAILABLE
